BUILDPLAN.md T-24 (M4).

The organizer runbook: successor to `mvp/README.md`'s run-of-show for the built room; host script per phase; the statements that option text is public and that a Rust-expert host can infer the answer; the rehearsal and field-notes sheets pointed at the build

Criteria: AC-51, AC-62, AC-63, AC-90
Harness hooks: see EVALUATION.md rows for those IDs; `just test` is the inner loop (≤ 60 s).
Depends on (BUILDPLAN): T-09, T-20
BUILDPLAN notes: —

Workflow mode: fast-track. Terminal pre-merge status: review. PR base: origin/main.
Standing clauses: criteria outrank SPEC on behaviour, state, payloads and copy; SPEC outranks the prototype, which wins on visual detail only. Never write down what a program prints. Answer position is a uniform draw from the date, never balanced. Miri proves absence of UB on executed paths only. Colour is never the only signal. Code never causes horizontal page scroll. Never `git add -A`. Signing goes through 1Password: retry once, then escalate.

Plan: filled in by the delegator's plan phase.

data.body: ORCHESTRATOR note for T-24 (from PQ-25, 2026-10-04): the runbook ticket is cleared, when dispatched, to add two justfile recipes beside bank-audit — 'schedule *ARGS' and 'sync *ARGS', each 'cd pipeline && uv run --offline --no-sync python -m popquiz.schedule <sub> {{ ARGS }}' — and nothing else in the justfile. The runbook's run-of-show then names 'just schedule' and 'just sync'. PQ-25's README section documents the python -m form; align it in the same PR.

ORCHESTRATOR 2026-10-04 22:1x EDT — dispatched (fast-track) on the client's 'resume the run' (precedent 10-03 23:0x: an Orchestrator-owned hold lifts on that word; this ticket has no owner gate). Base origin/main @ de1da5f (PR #47 merged; every room feature the runbook drives has landed). Rulings for the brief: (1) the runbook lives at docs/RUNBOOK.md and is the sole carrier of SPEC §8.1's two sentences (PQ-34 removed them from the host screen; the test the EVALUATION row asks for is new and yours: web/test/runbook.test.js under just test-web); (2) the affirmation path is an open client decision (F-52) — the runbook states the gate as the code and contract have it today in ONE section titled so the ruling replaces it; it invents no interim path; (3) cleared shared/contract-adjacent files: justfile for exactly 'schedule *ARGS' and 'sync *ARGS' beside bank-audit (the 11:5x note), mvp/PRACTICE-RUN.md and mvp/FIELD-NOTES-TEMPLATE.md for the lines that point them at the built room only; (4) /Users/michellerojas/rust-nyc-pop-quiz/REHEARSAL-GUIDE.md (untracked, the client's 10-02 draft against a599e80) is prior art to read and verify, never to edit, delete or commit. Boot prompt: <worktree>/.claude/boot-prompt.md.
READY PQ-29 CWD /Users/michellerojas/rust-nyc-pop-quiz-worktrees/organizer-runbook HEAD de1da5fc69c648140cb9fefdbdcebe590ef0d346 BASE de1da5fc69c648140cb9fefdbdcebe590ef0d346 MODE active

ORCHESTRATOR 22:3x — READY verified (HEAD = BASE = de1da5f), in_planning seen. One fact for the runbook's deploy section, so a stale paragraph does not travel: room/README.md ~853–858 ('The trial org stops the machine … after about five minutes') is history. The client added a card to the Fly org during PQ-11 (2026-09-27, spending cap $10), and 'fly status' from this seat shows machine 837e23a79e2398 (v11) started 2026-09-29 and still running with its check passing. The runbook states the room runs on a paid org with a spending cap and says nothing about a five-minute shutdown; the stale README paragraph is out of your scope (room/README.md is not cleared) and is logged on PQ-50. The in-memory-ledger restart rule (~846–850) is still true and still yours to carry.

QUESTION PQ-29: schedule.py exposes a third subcommand, 'reserve' (prints the reserve count, trend and warning alone). Per the brief there is no third recipe; the runbook names only just schedule / just sync, which print the reserve first. Should a 'reserve *ARGS' recipe follow in a later ticket? Not blocking. CONTRACT NOTE (not fixed): EVALUATION.md row AC-45 lists the host actions as 'Put it on the screen', 'Let's walk it', 'Release the room'; SPEC §11 Host, actions and web/shared/copy.js ship 'Start', 'Trace', 'End Pop Quiz'. The runbook follows §11 and the shipped buttons.

ORCHESTRATOR 22:4x — QUESTION answered: no 'reserve' recipe in this PR (the 11:5x clearance is exactly two recipes; the head already carries a passing review). The runbook may name 'python -m popquiz.schedule reserve' once as the reserve-only check if it does not already; otherwise schedule/sync printing the reserve first is enough. A 'just reserve' recipe is logged on PQ-50 as a small item for the next justfile touch. CONTRACT NOTE taken: EVALUATION.md's AC-45 row still names the pre-HC-0 host actions; SPEC §11 and the shipped buttons govern, as you did — routed upstream as F-53, not yours to fix. Seen from this seat: five G-signed commits at 6394b15, the diff exactly the brief's seven files, the justfile diff the two recipes and nothing else. The push prompt is the client's keystroke; carry on to gh pr create when it lands.

DONE PQ-29 PR https://github.com/mrojas54/rust-nyc-pop-quiz/pull/48 HEAD 6394b15ed6e44ce444e5839114378e8061f10379 BASE de1da5fc69c648140cb9fefdbdcebe590ef0d346 test-web 286 passed test-warm 11s CI: just test SUCCESS, just test-full SUCCESS. mutations: M1 one char of 8.1 options sentence -> AC-62 test; M2 one char of 8.1 host sentence -> AC-63 test; M3 delete pinned AC-90 sentence -> AC-90 test; M4 rename mvp/PRACTICE-RUN.md -> path test; M5 'just reserve' -> recipe test; M6 'Turn to your neighbour' in a Say line -> Forbidden test; M7 same on a wrapped Say continuation -> Forbidden test; M8 stale button label -> host-action test; M9 control (re-wrapped 8.1 sentence) passes. deviations: (1) test is CommonJS with __dirname, not import.meta.url — every web/test suite and _load.js is CJS; (2) recipe regex widened to ^([a-z][a-z0-9_-]*)( [^:]*)?: because the brief's form misses smoke/burst/wall-layout (smoke is named in the runbook); (3) validation ran 'schedule q3 --date 2026-10-14 --no-push --out $TMPDIR/runbook-check' — the brief's --room plus --no-push is rejected by argparse (mutually exclusive group); (4) added a seventh test beyond the brief (host-script button labels are §11 host actions), from the review; (5) the runbook prints fly/op/just smoke commands I could not run (no Fly, no token, no deploy): quoted from room/README.md and the justfile, not executed; room/README gives no command to read the deployed version, so the runbook says deploy from an up-to-date main and invents none. notes: KEPT from REHEARSAL-GUIDE — its structure (prepare/schedule/create/before/run/fails/after/sheet), the failure table's shape and rows (empty question= 400, 'No question is scheduled with that id.', unauthorized upload, Discord denial, 'already been run', lost phone, clipping, answer during walk-through, host asks for contribution), never rename a used question, lights up, observer holds the sheet; CORRECTED — raw PUT replaced by just schedule; button labels are §11's (Start/Trace/End Pop Quiz, not Put it on the screen/Let's walk it/Release the room); generation/review stated per ticket; sync-before-restart and deploy order added; trial-org machine stop flagged as fatal for a real night. Pinned AC-90 sentence: 'The Pop Quiz is one question, and it is scheduled last: after the last talk, with nothing after it, and the wrap-up releases the room.' Sheet lines: mvp/PRACTICE-RUN.md +5 lines at the top of ## Before (a 'Which room.' paragraph, before 'Drive prototypes/...'); mvp/FIELD-NOTES-TEMPLATE.md +1 header line '**Condition:** the deck, hands only / the built room, phones' after Runner/Date/Question, and +3 lines (blank + 2-line paragraph) after the hands-only paragraph pointing at docs/RUNBOOK.md. Code review PASS-WITH-NITS on 382aada; Major (smoke-q3 scheduling) and all Minors fixed in 6394b15. Also: QUESTION comment posted on a 'reserve' recipe and the EVALUATION AC-45 row's stale action labels; the sandbox's uv cache path needs UV_CACHE_DIR and the room tests need loopback binding (environment, not code). Ticket status: review.

ORCHESTRATOR 23:0x — FIX-BACK (review cycle 2 of the cap), one Major, docs-only. docs/RUNBOOK.md:120–122 says the Fly org has no payment method, that Fly stops the machine after about five minutes, and tells the organizer to add a card. That is the stale room/README.md paragraph; the 22:3x comment on this ticket gave the current fact: the client added a card to the Fly org on 2026-09-27 (spending cap $10), and 'fly status' from the Orchestrator seat shows machine 837e23a79e2398 (v11) started 2026-09-29 and still running with its check passing. Rewrite those lines as the paid-org fact — a card with a spending cap; the machine runs until something stops or redeploys it — and keep what is true beside it: a restart or a deploy loses every room and every scheduled question, so 'just sync' comes first. Check the rest of the runbook and the two sheets for the same claim (rg -i 'card|trial|payment|five minutes'); the PR body is clean, leave it. Then: 'just test-web' and 'just test' green, one G-signed commit over 6394b15, push (the client's keystroke in your tab), and a FIXED comment here: 'FIXED PQ-29 HEAD <sha> test-web <N> test-warm <s> changed: docs/RUNBOOK.md:<lines>'. Do not open a new PR; the head moves on #48. The fresh exact-head review from this seat is running on 6394b15 in parallel; if it adds findings they come as a second comment — this one does not wait for it.
